speaker: Howard
text: No, I want to blend in. Do what? Toy Story?

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: Hi, boys. Howdy to you, too. You got here quick. Well, come on in. Can I, can I get you something to drink?

speaker: Howard
text: Howdy, ma'am.

speaker: Leonard
text: Will you please take that stupid hat off? Uh, we took the red eye.

speaker: Howard
text: Thank you kindly.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, thank you.

speaker: Howard
text: If y'all don't mind, I got a hankering for a Lone Star beer.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: There's no alcohol in this household. Stop talking like that and lose the hat.

speaker: Howard
text: Sorry. I'll take a Diet Yoo-Hoo if you have it.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: You'll take a Coke. What about you? Ranch, is it? Oh, you still having trouble talking to the ladies?

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: Because, you know, at our church, we have a woman who's an amazing healer. Mostly she does, uh, crutch and wheelchair people. But I bet she'd be willing to take a shot at whatever third world demon is running around inside of you.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, if you don't mind, Mrs. Cooper, there's a 305 nonstop back to Los Angeles, and you have no idea how much I want to be on it.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: A girl? Oh, good. I've been praying for you. Oh, Sheldon.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, yes, ma'am.

speaker: Leonard
text: We came to apologize. And bring you home. So why don't you pack up your stuff and we'll head back?

speaker: Sheldon
text: What are they doing here? No, this is my home now. Thanks to you, my career is over. I'll spend the rest of my life here in Texas trying to teach evolution to creationists.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: You watch your mouth, Shelly. Everyone's entitled to their opinion.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Evolution isn't an opinion. It's fact.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: And that is your opinion.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I forgive you. Let's go home.

speaker: Mary Cooper
text: Don't tell me prayer doesn't work.

speaker: Leonard
text: How about that? Finally caught a break. You know how they say when friends have sex, it can get weird? Why does it have to get weird?

speaker: Penny
text: Uh-huh. Sure.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't know.

speaker: Leonard
text: I mean, we were friends and now we're more than friends. We're whatever this is. But label it, right? I mean, it is what it is.

speaker: Penny
text: I know. It's weird.

speaker: Leonard
text: Totally.
